title: Learn Your First Irish Dance Jig: START HERE!

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the beginner jig step-by-step with verbal anatomical details and close-up angles. He maintains an encouraging, instructional tone throughout.

Detailed breakdown of foot positioning, posture, and the opening step

metaphors: almost as if there's like a string connected to our knee

quotes.text: Today we're focusing more on beginner material.
When we first learn Irish dancing, we learn the posture, we learn the feet.
That helps us spring into the air.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates foot positioning close to the ground, showing inside ankles forward.
